_scale: 1 px = 0.5 mm (Fagi is ~9 mm long, like a Formica worker). The map is 64 x 43 cm.
_clock: Movement, sight, smell and pheromone run in real time. Only physiology is compressed: 1 s of game = 8 min of ant, keeping the real ratio between thirst and hunger.

THIRST._note: Without water a worker dries out in ~1 day (average humidity) -> 180 s. Drinking until the crop is full takes ~20 s.

HUNGER._note: With water she lasts ~1 week without food: 5-7 times longer than without water -> ~1250 s.

POINT_TYPES._note: A drop of nectar or fallen fruit lasts ~1 day before fermenting -> 180 s. The rest in proportion.

FAGI._note: An ant's compound eyes cover almost all around (~280 degrees), but at low resolution: a 3 mm drop stops being visible at ~6 cm (120 px). Speed 70 px/s = 3.5 cm/s, already realistic.

PHERO._note: A Lasius niger trail has a half-life of ~47 min. 600 s is already the right order of magnitude (it was 45 s).

EXPLORE._note: New workers take learning walks near the nest and widen the radius with experience; they have no innate urge to wander off. Known ground is forgotten in days, not hours.

MEMORY._note: Forgetting is biology: it runs on the physiological clock (1 s = 8 min). An ant remembers a feeder visited once for ~1 day, a few days if repeated, and weeks if consolidated. Her path integration fails with distance travelled, not with time standing still: the remembered place barely drifts.
